mapper.sql: transfer_orders.id AS id, transfer_orders.to_code AS toNumber, transfer_orders.from_location_group_id AS fromWarehouseId, transfer_orders.to_location_group_id AS toWarehouseId, from_location_groups.name AS fromWarehouseName, to_location_groups.name AS toWarehouseName, transfer_orders.order_date AS orderDate, transfer_orders.fulfillment_date AS fulfillmentDate, transfer_orders.status AS status

FROM transfer_orders LEFT JOIN location_groups AS from_location_groups ON from_location_groups.id = transfer_orders.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups AS to_location_groups ON to_location_groups.id = transfer_orders.to_location_group_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT products.parent_id) FROM transfer_orders INNER JOIN transfer_order_details ON transfer_orders.id = transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id INNER JOIN products ON products.parent_id = transfer_order_details.product_id

SELECT COUNT(transfer_orders.id) FROM transfer_orders INNER JOIN transfer_order_details ON transfer_orders.id=transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id
GROUP BY product_id

SELECT SUM(subquery.qty_converted) AS qty, SUM(subquery.row_cost) AS grandDetailTotalCost FROM ( SELECT transfer_order_details.qty * transfer_order_details.conversion AS qty_converted, IFNULL( (SELECT cost FROM inventory_valuations WHERE is_active = 1 AND pid = transfer_order_details.product_id AND date <= transfer_orders.order_date ORDER BY date DESC, created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) / NULLIF(products.small_val_uom, 0) * (transfer_order_details.qty * transfer_order_details.conversion), 0 ) AS row_cost FROM transfer_orders INNER JOIN transfer_order_details ON transfer_orders.id = transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id INNER JOIN products ON products.id = transfer_order_details.product_id
) AS subquery

SELECT transfer_orders.id AS id, 'Transfer Order' AS type, CONCAT_WS(' ', products.code, products.name) AS productName, transfer_orders.order_date AS `date`, transfer_orders.to_code AS toNumber, lg_from.name AS fromWarehouseName, lg_to.name AS toWarehouseName, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, IFNULL(transfer_order_details.qty, 0) AS qty, uoms.name AS uom, ((SELECT cost FROM inventory_valuations WHERE is_active = 1 AND pid = transfer_order_details.product_id AND date <= transfer_orders.order_date ORDER BY date DESC, created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) / IFNULL(products.small_val_uom, 1)) AS unitCost FROM transfer_orders INNER JOIN transfer_order_details ON transfer_orders.id=transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id INNER JOIN products ON products.id=transfer_order_details.product_id INNER JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = transfer_order_details.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg_from ON lg_from.id = transfer_orders.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg_to ON lg_to.id = transfer_orders.to_location_group_id
AND product_id = #{parentId}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(parent.id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(parent.id) END AS parent_count FROM transfer_orders INNER JOIN transfer_order_details ON transfer_orders.id=transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id LEFT JOIN products ON products.parent_id = transfer_order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN products AS parent ON products.parent_id = products.id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg_from ON lg_from.id = transfer_orders.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg_to ON lg_to.id = transfer_orders.to_location_group_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = transfer_order_details.qty_uom_id

SELECT SUM(totalCost) AS grandTotal FROM ( SELECT IFNULL( (SELECT cost FROM inventory_valuations WHERE is_active = 1 AND pid = transfer_order_details.product_id AND date <= transfer_orders.order_date ORDER BY date DESC, created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) / NULLIF(transfer_order_details.conversion, 0) * transfer_order_details.qty, 0 ) AS totalCost FROM transfer_orders INNER JOIN transfer_order_details ON transfer_orders.id = transfer_order_details.transfer_order_id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = transfer_order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN products AS parent ON products.parent_id = parent.id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg_from ON lg_from.id = transfer_orders.from_location_group_id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg_to ON lg_to.id = transfer_orders.to_location_group_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = transfer_order_details.qty_uom_id
) AS subquery
